dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'C' and 'O' shaped light patches bounded by dark, jagged perimeters; prominent structures in the upper-right dorsal region exhibit a distinct gradient from dark outer edges to lighter tan/grey internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters on the mid-lateral flank and lower tail region, appearing as asymmetrical solid patches with sharp contrast against the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis extending longitudinally toward the posterior; the relationship between the primary lateral blob and the two closest dorsal annuli creates a compact triangular cluster.
